quandoUsar: Pricing section that compares two plans row by row, with a switch between monthly and annual billing and a filter to show only the differences.
Starting point for editing: plans, prices, and features are constants at the top of the file, ready to be replaced with your own.
quandoEvitar: Use `comparison-table` to compare your product with competitors, with a sticky header and a highlighted column.
Use `billing-toggle` when you only need the period switch with rolling prices, in plan cards.
For three or more plans the block does not work as is: the grid and the `Feature` type have exactly two columns, Team and Studio.

teclado.acao: In the period selector, switch between monthly and annual and move focus along (`segmented-control`).
On the “Show differences only” switch, turn the filter on or off; on a plan button, select or clear the selection.

acessibilidade: The matrix uses ARIA table roles (`table`, `row`, `columnheader`, `rowheader`, `cell`), and each value carries the plan name in hidden text, so it makes sense read on its own.
The plan buttons expose `aria-pressed` and a `role="status"` region announces the chosen plan; each plan's price sits in an `aria-live="polite"` region with `aria-atomic`.
The filter is the `switch` labeled “Show differences only” and the period is the `segmented-control` named “Billing period”.
movimento: Switching the period makes each price count up to the new value in 0.24 s, and the “N of 8 features” count follows the filter.

Turning on the filter collapses the height of the identical feature rows on a spring that does not overshoot and reopens them with a fade; choosing a plan tints the column and a 2 px rail slides to it.
With “reduce motion” on, the numbers change instantly, rows enter and leave without animation, and the rail jumps.
responsivo: The layout follows the block's width, measured by a `ResizeObserver`: up to 720 px the intro stacks and the margins shrink; up to 540 px the feature name moves above the two values and the “What changes” column disappears.
notasIA: `PlanComparison` takes no props: edit `features` (with `shared: true` on what the filter hides) and `pricing` at the top of the file, and the hardcoded texts in the JSX.
The “Select …” buttons only mark the plan with `aria-pressed`, with no callback; hook up your checkout by replacing their `onClick`.
The “Included” and “Not included” values are compared as exact text to get the checkmark and the muted tone; the block depends on `button`, `segmented-control`, and `switch`.
